sources.title: NiNformer: A Network in Network Transformer with Token Mixing Generated ...
sources.snippet: The NiNformer is a deep learning model that integrates the Network-in-Network (NiN) architecture with a Transformer-based design. NiN allows the model to learn more complex and hierarchical features by applying multiple convolutional layers within each stage of the network.

sources.title: Abdullah Nazhat Abdullah X arXiv:2403.02411v3 [cs.CV] 20 May 2024
sources.snippet: Apply global average pooling to the output of the last Transformer block. Use a fully connected layer with C output units and softmax activation to obtain class probabilities. Train the model by minimizing the loss between predicted and true labels using gradient descent with learning rate η.
